- Validate inputs and order: if x > y, return -1; else determine the candidate upper bound as floor of y (convert to int if needed).
- Compute the largest even integer ≤ y: if upper bound is odd, subtract 1 to get candidate_even.
- Check range: if candidate_even >= ceil of x (i.e., candidate_even >= smallest integer ≥ x) and candidate_even ≥ 0, return candidate_even; otherwise return -1.
